title: SALEG (Sachsen-Anhaltische Landesentwicklungsgesellschaft mbH)
description: SALEG (Sachsen-Anhaltische Landesentwicklungsgesellschaft mbH) is a state-owned land development company belonging to the German federal state of Saxony-Anhalt. The organization specializes in urban and regional planning, brownfield redevelopment, land resource management, and the support of infrastructure projects. It operates as a service partner for local municipalities, coordinating and implementing spatial development programs in the interests of the public sector.
